messages:
taylor: heads up — canary promotion for release/2026.03 failed and is blocking the cut. build-step image extract is erroring out during staging e2e: `tar: unexpected EOF`. need quick unblock plan.

dev-deploy-bot: Promote canary job failed: <https://ci.internal/redwood/12345|ci/job/12345> — status: failed. Auto-promotion halted. Manual intervention required. :warning:

elaine: i pulled the job logs, looks like the docker layer blob stream truncated during `docker load` after cache restore. snippet:
```
Loading layer sha256:abcd... failed: tar: unexpected EOF
error: failed to extract layer
```

ravi: is this the same pattern as last week (registry blob mount partial)? or a CI cache corruption? we saw s3 multipart retries flaky.

taylor: similar symptoms but different service. we have a change window in ~2h; we can either roll the canary back to previous tag or attempt a quick rebuild without cache. thoughts?

sam: quick mitigation — rerun the job with cache disabled for the restore step (set `CI_RESTORE_CACHE=false` for this job). slower but most likely to succeed fast. temporary, revert after cut.

elaine: we can also pin the base image by digest for the release job to avoid using a floating tag. example:
```
IMAGE=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:3f9c27a8...
sed -i 's|runtime:latest|runtime@sha256:3f9c27a8...|' .ci/pipeline.yml
```
If we do that we should also update the release notes and the rollback doc.

ops-sre: +1 to pinning for the hotpath. alternative is to rollback the canary and cut from previous artifact `release-2026.03.14@sha256:...` until we investigate registry mount retries. I'll take ownership of the rollback if we go that route.

taylor: ok — decision: rollback canary now to previous artifact (ops-sre to execute) to unblock the release window. ravi, please open a follow-up to investigate registry blob partial transfers and retries. elaine, please pin the image in the release pipeline as a short-term safety. sam — run the rerun-without-cache if rollback runs into any issue.

dev-deploy-bot: Manual rollback requested by taylor. Canaries reverted to `release-2026.03.14`. Stopping promotion pipeline. See <https://ci.internal/redwood/rollback/6789|rollback/6789> for details.

sam: started a CI rerun with `CI_RESTORE_CACHE=false` on job 12346, ETA ~12m.

sam: ✅ re-run succeeded, e2e passed (job 12346). but note runtime build time +3m without cache. leaving job link in the thread.

elaine: I'll open an incident ticket and include the logs + reproducer. plan to audit registry upload flow and retry/backoff. will add action item to try `s3:GetObject` partial-read detection.

ravi: raised follow-up PR to pin runtime digest in .ci/pipeline.yml and added a short changelog note. linking PR: <https://git.internal/redwood/pull/4321|pr/4321>

taylor: thanks everyone. ops-sre—once rollback audit is done, coordinate with me for re-promote. I'll brief customer-facing teams about the short delay and the rollback. :thumbsup:
